title: RF-1 Geohazard Screening Report

executiveSummary.text: This screening run covers a 3.0 km analysis radius around the AOI at 49.2193, -122.5984 in EPSG:32610. The risk summary shows 40.7344% Low, 22.1264% Moderate, 33.2586% High, and 3.8806% Extreme pixels across 360,000 total pixels. The top 25 hotspots are all catalogued as Extreme, and the soil survey coverage is 93.023%, leaving some pixels without surveyed soil coverage. Sentinel-1 GRD data were unavailable for this run.

keyFindings.statement: The analysis grid contains 360,000 pixels in total for the reported run.
The risk summary catalogues 14.6644 km2 of Low, 7.9655 km2 of Moderate, 11.9731 km2 of High, and 1.3970 km2 of Extreme pixels.
The Extreme band represents 3.8806% of the analysis grid, while High represents 33.2586%.
All 25 listed hotspots are catalogued as risk band Extreme with risk score 25.
Sentinel-1 GRD coverage is unavailable for this run.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.body: This run uses the RF-1 formula risk_score = s_rating * c_rating, with band definitions of Low (1 to 4), Moderate (5 to 9), High (10 to 19), and Extreme (20 to 25). The AOI is centered at 49.2193, -122.5984, analysed in EPSG:32610 at 10.0 m resolution within a 3.0 km radius. This report only describes the deterministic outputs supplied for the run and does not infer values beyond the evidence provided.

sections.heading: Source coverage
sections.body: Several source tables were available for this run, including ALOS PALSAR mosaic items, BC bedrock geology, BC geological faults, BC quaternary geology, BC soil project boundaries, BC soil survey polygons, Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ESA WorldCover, Harmonized global biomass, Esri land use / land cover, the single-collection satellite demo table, Sentinel-1 RTC, and Sentinel-2 L2A. Sentinel-1 GRD was unavailable. The soil survey polygons were catalogued as covering 93.023% of the analysis grid, or 334,883 of 360,000 pixels, leaving the remaining pixels without surveyed soil coverage.

sections.heading: Risk distribution
sections.body: The band summary shows Low at 146,644 pixels (40.7344%), Moderate at 79,655 pixels (22.1264%), High at 119,731 pixels (33.2586%), and Extreme at 13,970 pixels (3.8806%). Within the matrix, the largest individual cell counts are S=2/C=2 at 92,621 pixels and S=2/C=5 at 42,656 pixels, with S=5/C=5 catalogued as Extreme at 12,029 pixels. No additional distribution details were supplied beyond these tabulated counts.

limitations.text: Screening-level output. RF-1 ratings use availability-weighted proxies over public data and are not a substitute for site investigation or engineering assessment.
Susceptibility blends indirect remote-sensing proxies with surveyed soil polygons; only the soil survey is direct ground truth.
Sentinel-1 GRD data were unavailable for this run.
Surveyed soil polygons cover 93.023% of the analysis grid, so some pixels lack surveyed soil coverage.

dataGaps.text: The Fabric data-agent tool was unavailable, so no additional bounded aggregate queries could be answered beyond the supplied evidence.
No hotspot-specific attributes beyond those listed in the supplied evidence were available to report.

disclaimer: This output is an automated screening summary for demonstration purposes. It is not a site investigation, hazard certification, engineering design, or substitute for review by qualified geotechnical and geospatial professionals using authoritative local data.
